## [L10] 1 个任务 · 层内可并行

### [L10-01] 日清汇总(新)-多日(V2)

- jobId：`2076919814328287232`
- 产出：`js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_global`（mode=append，主键 PHID）
- 依赖上层：「机组日清结果转横表（新）-多日(V4)」(L7)、「阻塞盈余电费-多日(V2)」(L9)

**输出 1/1 → js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_global**

```sql
-- CTE 对照（编号即 WITH 定义顺序 = 数据流顺序）
-- t1   输入  js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_unit_report
-- t2   输入  js_produce.t_dnl_day_24result_global
-- t3   步骤
-- t4   步骤
-- t5   计算
-- t6   步骤
-- t7   计算
-- t8   输出投影
WITH t1 AS (
SELECT PHID,pdate,month,version_id,plant_id,plant_name,unit_id,unit_name,power_company_id,power_company_name,power_type,power_type_name,settle_type,settle_type_name,trade_types,trade_types_name,settle_item,settle_item_name,data_type,sum_value,v1,v2,v3,v4,v5,v6,v7,v8,v9,v10,v11,v12,v13,v14,v15,v16,v17,v18,v19,v20,v21,v22,v23,v24,update_time,update_by,update_name,app_type,app_type_name,base_type,base_type_name,order_num,voltage_level_code,voltage_level_name,power_price_class,is_ahead_clear,is_ahead_clear_name FROM js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_unit_report WHERE (DATA_TYPE = '电费') AND (PDATE IN ( '2026-04-01' )) AND (SETTLE_ITEM IN ('00', '06', '06_1', '07_3', '07')) AND (SETTLE_TYPE IN ('1', '2', '5', '9')) AND (VERSION_ID IN ( '78_20260401_1' ))
),
t2 AS (
SELECT PHID,pdate,month,item,item_name,tpoint,VALUE,update_time,update_by,version_id FROM js_produce.t_dnl_day_24result_global WHERE (ITEM != '1@00' AND ITEM != '1@06' AND ITEM != '1@07' AND ITEM != '1@07_3' AND ITEM != '4@07_3' AND ITEM != '4@07' AND ITEM != '4@00' AND ITEM != '13@00' AND ITEM != '13@07_3' AND ITEM != '13@07' AND ITEM != '4@06' AND ITEM != '9@06' AND ITEM != '9@00' AND ITEM != '9@07' AND ITEM != '9@07_3') AND (PDATE IN ( '2026-04-01' )) AND (VERSION_ID IN ( '78_20260401_1' ))
),
t3 AS (
SELECT PDATE,MONTH,VERSION_ID,SETTLE_TYPE,SETTLE_ITEM,SETTLE_ITEM_NAME,sum(SUM_VALUE) AS VALUE FROM t1 GROUP BY PDATE,MONTH,VERSION_ID,SETTLE_TYPE,SETTLE_ITEM,SETTLE_ITEM_NAME 
),
t4 AS (
SELECT MONTH,PDATE,UPDATE_BY,VERSION_ID,ITEM,ITEM_NAME,sum(VALUE) AS VALUE FROM t2 GROUP BY MONTH,PDATE,UPDATE_BY,VERSION_ID,ITEM,ITEM_NAME 
),
t5 AS (
SELECT
*
,CAST(CAST(`SETTLE_ITEM_NAME` as STRING) as STRING) AS `item_name`,
CAST(case when (CAST(`SETTLE_TYPE` as STRING)  =  '1' )  then concat('1@',CAST(`SETTLE_ITEM` as STRING))  when (CAST(`SETTLE_TYPE` as STRING)  =  '2' )  then concat('4@',CAST(`SETTLE_ITEM` as STRING))  when (CAST(`SETTLE_TYPE` as STRING)  =  '9' )  then concat('9@',CAST(`SETTLE_ITEM` as STRING))   else concat('5@',CAST(`SETTLE_ITEM` as STRING))   end as STRING) AS `ITEM`
FROM t3
),
t6 AS (
(SELECT ITEM, ITEM_NAME, MONTH, PDATE, VALUE, VERSION_ID FROM t5)
UNION ALL
(SELECT ITEM, ITEM_NAME, MONTH, PDATE, VALUE, VERSION_ID FROM t4)
),
t7 AS (
SELECT
*
,DATE_FORMAT(CAST(CAST('管理员' AS STRING) as STRING),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS `update_name`,
CAST(uuid() as STRING) AS `PHID`,
CAST(CAST('admin6' AS STRING) as STRING) AS `update_by`,
DATE_FORMAT(CAST(CAST('2026-07-14 14:40:41' AS STRING) as STRING),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS `update_time`
FROM t6
),
t8 AS (
SELECT t7.ITEM,t7.ITEM_NAME,t7.MONTH,t7.PDATE,t7.VALUE,t7.VERSION_ID,t7.UPDATE_TIME,t7.PHID,t7.UPDATE_BY FROM t7
) SELECT * FROM t8
```

## [L11] 1 个任务 · 层内可并行

### [L11-01] 日清算预分摊电费-多日(V2)

- jobId：`2076919814332481536`
- 产出：`js_produce.t_dnl_day_pre_allocation_dtl`（mode=append，主键 PHID）
- 依赖上层：「计算后统计-多日(V2)」(L8)、「日清汇总(新)-多日(V2)」(L10)

**输出 1/1 → js_produce.t_dnl_day_pre_allocation_dtl**

```sql
-- CTE 对照（编号即 WITH 定义顺序 = 数据流顺序）
-- t1   输入  js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_global
-- t2   输入  js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_custom
-- t3   输入  js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_salecompany
-- t4   过滤
-- t5   过滤
-- t6   步骤
-- t7   步骤
-- t8   步骤
-- t9   步骤
-- t10  关联
-- t11  关联
-- t12  关联
-- t13  计算
-- t14  输出投影
WITH t1 AS (
SELECT PHID,pdate,month,item,item_name,VALUE,update_time,update_by,version_id FROM js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_global WHERE (PDATE IN ( '2026-04-01' )) AND (VERSION_ID IN ( '78_20260401_1' ))
),
t2 AS (
SELECT PHID,pdate,month,custom_id,custom_name,settle_item,settle_item_name,energy,price,fee,update_time,update_by,version_id FROM js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_custom WHERE (PDATE IN ( '2026-04-01' )) AND (SETTLE_ITEM = '00') AND (VERSION_ID IN ( '78_20260401_1' ))
),
t3 AS (
SELECT PHID,pdate,month,custom_id,custom_name,settle_item,settle_item_name,energy,price,fee,update_time,update_by,version_id FROM js_produce.t_dnl_day_result_salecompany WHERE (PDATE IN ( '2026-04-01' )) AND (SETTLE_ITEM = '00') AND (VERSION_ID IN ( '78_20260401_1' ))
),
t4 AS (
SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE ITEM in ('1@06_5','1@06_1','CUSTOM_BALANCE_FEE')
),
t5 AS (
SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE ITEM in ('2@06','3@06')
),
t6 AS (
(SELECT UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, VERSION_ID, CUSTOM_ID, CUSTOM_NAME, ENERGY, MONTH, PDATE FROM t2)
UNION ALL
(SELECT UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, VERSION_ID, CUSTOM_ID, CUSTOM_NAME, ENERGY, MONTH, PDATE FROM t3)
),
t7 AS (
select t.pdate,t.month ,
       sum(case t.item when 'CUSTOM_BALANCE_FEE' then t.value else 0 end) BALANCE_FE,
       sum(case t.item when '1@06_5' then t.value else 0 end) run_fee,
       sum(case t.item when '1@06_1' then t.value else 0 end) FIRING_FEE
from t4 t group by t.pdate,t.month
),
t8 AS (
SELECT PDATE,sum(VALUE) AS deviation_income_fee FROM t5 GROUP BY PDATE 
),
t9 AS (
SELECT MONTH,PDATE,sum(ENERGY) AS SCHDL FROM t6 GROUP BY MONTH,PDATE 
),
t10 AS (
SELECT t8.DEVIATION_INCOME_FEE, t7.PDATE, t7.MONTH, t7.BALANCE_FE, t7.RUN_FEE, t7.FIRING_FEE FROM t8 RIGHT JOIN t7 ON t8.PDATE = t7.PDATE
),
t11 AS (
SELECT t6.UPDATE_BY, t6.UPDATE_TIME, t6.VERSION_ID, t6.CUSTOM_ID, t6.CUSTOM_NAME, t6.ENERGY, t10.DEVIATION_INCOME_FEE, t10.PDATE, t10.MONTH, t10.BALANCE_FE, t10.RUN_FEE, t10.FIRING_FEE FROM t6 RIGHT JOIN t10 ON t6.PDATE = t10.PDATE
),
t12 AS (
SELECT t9.SCHDL, t11.UPDATE_BY, t11.UPDATE_TIME, t11.VERSION_ID, t11.CUSTOM_ID, t11.CUSTOM_NAME, t11.ENERGY, t11.DEVIATION_INCOME_FEE, t11.PDATE, t11.MONTH, t11.BALANCE_FE, t11.RUN_FEE, t11.FIRING_FEE FROM t9 RIGHT JOIN t11 ON t9.PDATE = t11.PDATE
),
t13 AS (
SELECT
*
,CAST(-1*COALESCE(`BALANCE_FE`,0.0)*CAST(`ENERGY` as STRING)/COALESCE(`SCHDL`,0.0) as DECIMAL(38,8)) AS `balance_share_fee`,
CAST(COALESCE(`DEVIATION_INCOME_FEE`,0.0)*CAST(`ENERGY` as STRING)/COALESCE(`SCHDL`,0.0)*-1 as DECIMAL(38,8)) AS `deviation_income_share_fee`,
CAST(COALESCE(`FIRING_FEE`,0.0)*CAST(`ENERGY` as STRING)/COALESCE(`SCHDL`,0.0) as DECIMAL(38,8)) AS `firing_share_fee`,
CAST(uuid() as STRING) AS `PHID`,
CAST(COALESCE(`RUN_FEE`,0.0)*CAST(`ENERGY` as STRING)/COALESCE(`SCHDL`,0.0) as DECIMAL(38,8)) AS `run_share_fee`
FROM t12
),
t14 AS (
SELECT t13.UPDATE_BY,t13.UPDATE_TIME,t13.VERSION_ID,t13.CUSTOM_ID,t13.CUSTOM_NAME,t13.PDATE,t13.FIRING_SHARE_FEE,t13.DEVIATION_INCOME_SHARE_FEE,t13.BALANCE_SHARE_FEE,t13.PHID,t13.RUN_SHARE_FEE FROM t13
) SELECT * FROM t14
```
